0-nfl.first_audit_reason: Three passages must change. (1) Hook section, 'the matched-book comparison against Friday's 6:12 PM EDT snapshot showed no change,' and the countercase line 'a market that has not moved since Friday evening' are misleading. The median held at 44.5 across 11 matched books, but Fanatics moved from 44.5 at 6:12 PM EDT Friday to 45 at 7:11 AM EDT Saturday. Say the median was unchanged and note the Fanatics move. (2) Hook section, 'which has been the Steelers' pattern on all three of his international trips,' is unsupported. CBS Sports reported that one of those trips was with the Jets (London, 2024). Rodgers said 'we've left on Thursday early evening' in each country, which refers to his teams, not the Steelers on all three trips. (3) Final section, 'weather-controlled stadium reports,' is unsupported. No source says Stade de France is weather-controlled. Remove it or replace it with a sourced weather reference. Also recommended: replace 'the reporting we reviewed' and 'the reporting we saw' with time-stamped public statements. For example: 'As of 7:13 AM EDT Saturday, neither team had announced its inactive players.' Odds times, the model figures (45.3, 23.0 and 22.3, inputs through Oct. 19), the Dublin 24-21 score and the Prisco characterizations otherwise match the sources.
